blocks.costs: TPOT rises when answers do not copy the prompt, and at high concurrency; a slower start
blocks.name: ngram-speculation
blocks.reason: prompts are long (median 494 words beyond what they share). N-gram speculation drafts tokens by copying spans of the prompt, so it only helps when answers quote or repeat their input; otherwise it costs a little - compare TPOT with and without it. Replaying prompt lookup on this run's answers, drafts would supply 17.9% of all output tokens, and 8.2% is needed to pay for the 4.5 ms each step adds (measured on an A10G at 32 running requests; this run's step is 51 ms)
